text:
ravi: quick thought: what if we add a collapsible left "Invoices" pane (desktop) + a mobile FAB that opens the same panel. keeps header clean but gives a persistent entrypoint. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/leftpane-invoices mei: I like persistent access. Concern: left pane steals horizontal space for wide tables. Maybe make it collapsible by default and remember user preference. :memo: carmen: finance wants per-project downloads. Proposal: show a subtle per-row PDF icon for top projects, else move into kebab. For mobile, put the download action inside the accordion detail. lia: accessibility nits: the pane toggle needs aria-expanded, and when opened it should be a region with role="region" and aria-label="Invoices". If it behaves like a dialog (modal), trap focus; if not, ensure logical tab order. Also add aria-live for bulk exports: e.g.,
Export started for 5 invoices
. Non-color cues for invoice status badges required. ravi: copy nit: label the pane simply "Invoices". For token cards, change header to "Token usage" and add a tiny cost-per-token helper: "$0.0008 / token (avg)". mei: UX detail: show invoice status pill (Paid / Pending / Processing) next to download so users don't try to re-download processing exports. Tooltip explains each status. carmen: A/B test idea: Variant A = left pane + visible per-row icon for top N; Variant B = header Export + per-row in kebab only. Metrics: time-to-download, support tickets "where is my invoice", per-row vs bulk export ratio. Run 2 weeks. lia: keyboard shortcut suggestion for power users: press D when a row is focused to download that project's invoice. If implemented, ensure this shortcut doesn't conflict with assistive tech. Document it in accessibility notes. ravi: implementation notes: persist pane preference in local storage, expose setting in account prefs for teams. Carmen, can you mock top-N rule for the per-row icon? carmen: yes, I'll mock with top 10 by usage and share a prototype frame by Thu. figma-bot: Uploaded frame "Left pane invoices + FAB" (desktop, mobile). Link: https://www.figma.com/proto/leftpane lia: I'll run NVDA + VoiceOver passes on the prototype once uploaded. I'll test: focus order, aria labels, aria-live announcements, and color contrast. mei: thanks team. if A wins, we ship left pane as default with an escape hatch to revert to header-only. if B wins, we keep header export primary and add a subtle hint in the UI pointing to kebab export. :thumbsup:
